rules: Vertical DONE is necessary but not sufficient for VERIFIED_CLOSED.
VERIFIED_CLOSED requires every applicable dimension VERIFIED; N_A is allowed only with a rationale; independent acceptance must be VERIFIED.
PARTIAL, MISSING, or BLOCKED in any applicable dimension forbids VERIFIED_CLOSED.
Dependencies must reference known stories and the dependency graph must be acyclic.
External, field, and upstream gates cannot be self-closed by repository mocks or same-owner evidence.
Latest-solution assessment may KEEP a stable implementation; novelty is not a closure requirement.

release_provenance.note: Use GitHub Artifact Attestations/Sigstore and SLSA provenance semantics rather than a private signing format.

durable_execution.note: Temporal confirms durable event history plus idempotent external operations as mature practice; keep SpatialRuntime's narrower evidence/reconciliation boundary rather than reimplementing a general workflow engine.

observability.note: Use OpenTelemetry for telemetry naming/correlation; do not promote telemetry success into authoritative external-effect truth.

functional_completeness.note: Main runtime episode and representative multi-step scenario are exercised.

state_completeness.note: Session/replay/durable-ledger state continuity is exercised.

integration_completeness.note: Closed-loop scenario and explicit application assembly are exercised.

security_correctness.note: Safety supervision and fail-closed pipeline behavior are exercised.

performance_scalability.note: The current SR-01 acceptance contract defines deterministic correctness, not a latency/throughput SLO; no performance claim is made.

maintainability.note: Scenario/runtime boundaries are versioned and documented.

observability_traceability.note: Execution manifest and replay evidence support traceability.

testability.note: Normal and failure/recovery paths have dedicated tests.

user_value_completeness.note: A representative user-facing runtime scenario reaches a verifiable result.

external_compatibility.note: SR-01 is the internal runtime contract; external protocol compatibility is handled by separate conformance stories.

independent_acceptance.note: Independent, negative, or external evidence is kept separate from implementation assertions.

solution_assessment.note: Keep the current boundary unless external evidence demonstrates a materially better mature replacement.
